test_matrix.evidence: Exercises POST /policies, PUT/DELETE /policies/{id}, POST /policies/evaluate, POST /tools/{id}/approve, and POST /tools/{id}/reject and expects removed-route status.
Seeds policy state directly, verifies GET /policies and GET /policies/{id}, and verifies policy mutation routes are removed.
Seeds a pending tool intent, verifies GET /tools/pending and denylist POST/DELETE keep paths, and verifies approval/rejection routes are removed.
Uses an httptest server that fails if contacted and asserts the client returns Nostr PolicyCreate guidance.
